_todo: Pens labels carry their SVB as a prefix (F = Fossli, H = Havna, V = Vallekilen) because the physical numbers repeat between SVBs (Havna 1-8 vs Fossli 1-7) and every part of the tool finds a pens by its label -- BoardConfig refuses to load duplicate labels. Havna: H1A/H1B (one 3-way pens, two motors -- two pens labels, each with its own motor + feedback), H2-H8 on Havna Motors -- 9 motors in total, still to be verified on the real board (PLAN_Phase3.md says 8). H1's panel side (one 3-position switch or two switches; which LEDs) not decided yet; H102/H104/H106 on Sidespor Motors (also driven from the Havna SVB).

addressMode is 'prod': every chip resolves to its virtual address (bus*0x10 + real address) from the 'bus' field below. The firmware selects the bus on the I2C mux before each access and ignores the mux's ACK, so on the bench without a mux the select does nothing and only the real address reaches the chip -- the same virtual addresses work with and without the mux.

'bus' values for Fossli Motors Hoyre/Venstre (2) come from PLAN_Phase1.md's earlier site-map table, not restated by the site owner in the message this file was built from. 'bus' for the other 6 boards is exactly what the site owner stated. Note: that same earlier table had Sidespor on bus 3, but the site owner's fresh statement says bus 0 -- trusting the fresh statement, flagging the discrepancy here rather than silently resolving it.

Switches are only known for Fossli Motors Hoyre ("1","3","5/6","7") and Fossli Motors Venstre ("101","2","4") -- the other 5 SCB/Combined boards' switches, motorBitFirst, dreieskive, and statusLedBit are all genuinely unknown, left null/empty rather than guessed. The site owner said these come later.

'All but one of the SCB-capable boards have the active status LED' per the site owner -- which one lacks it is not yet known, so statusLedBit is only populated for Fossli Motors Hoyre/Venstre (both bit 7, matching what's already built and tested) and left null everywhere else.

Havna Stillverk and Fossli Stillverk (SVB category) are declared here for visibility only -- no SVB panel-switch scanning/command functionality exists yet, so BoardConfig.Load() doesn't consume these into anything functional.

Vallekilen Stillverk is Combined (drives 2 motors + reads panel switches on one board) -- per the site owner, represented as one vaddr, declared once here with category Combined. It's consumed into BoardScb (so it'll show up in Motor Scan/Command Mode once its switches are known) but has no SVB-side functional support either, same as the pure SVB boards above.

Fossli Motors Venstre corrected a second time: motor and signal bits are NOT consecutive ranges on this board (discovered when firing 'motor bit 0' during Motor Scan lit a signal lamp instead of moving anything) -- motors and signals are interleaved on Port B (motors 1,3,5; signals 0,2,4). This is why motorBits/signalBits exist as explicit per-bit lists rather than a single 'first' value -- motorBitFirst/signalBitFirst alone can't represent an interleaved layout. Status LED moved 7->6, inverter-enable moved Port A bit 6->7 (swapped with track detection, which is now bit 6). EEPROM for this board holds data scanned under the OLD (wrong) declaration and needs re-scanning: re-upload hardware.json, re-run Motor Scan (choose Overwrite), re-run Signal Scan, re-run Track Detection with bit 6.
